note: SNS-2026-10-STAGE5-FEED-001: Stage 5 targeted Feed/Posts/Likes/Comments reliability repair. deleteTimelinePost now logs [SNS Feed] Post deletion failed: and does not remove post from UI on error. deletePostComment wrapped in try/catch with [SNS Feed] Comment deletion failed: logging and toast on failure. snxEditPost now logs [SNS Feed] Post update failed: and restores original text on failure. Post creation guards userData null before accessing displayName/username. serverTimestamp() used for createdAt/timestamp fields for authoritative server ordering; clientTs retained as numeric fallback. Feed onSnapshot error log normalized to [SNS Feed] prefix. Infinite scroll debounced to prevent duplicate initTimelineStream() calls. Feed state (_renderedPostIds, _feedInitialized, _pendingNewPosts, feedPosts DOM) fully cleared on logout to prevent previous-account data bleed. _postTimeAgo hardened against malformed/missing timestamps. Author name/handle fallbacks to 'Unknown User'/'unknown' in post and comment rendering. submitPostComment guards userData null. Bumped SW to v78.
